description: Index local repositories: generate per-user external indexes and add them to the local catalog. Pass discover:true to find repository roots under the given paths first. Pass dryRun:true to discover and report without writing any indexes or catalog (read-only); this replaces the old repo_discover tool. Without dryRun this mutates the persistent local catalog, so it is not a pure read.

discover.description: Discover repositories under the provided paths before indexing.

dryRun.description: Discover and report repositories without writing indexes or mutating the catalog. Read-only. Defaults to false.

paths.description: Repository paths, or roots when discover is true.

name: repo_index
title: Index Repositories
